whatItDoes: Estimates 2025 US federal income tax based on your annual gross income and filing status. It applies the standard deduction, walks the marginal tax brackets, and reports the estimated total tax, marginal rate, effective rate, and a per-bracket breakdown.
whyItExists: Most people only see the tax withheld from their paycheck and have no idea what it actually costs or which tax bracket their income lands in. A quick estimator makes take-home pay, raises, and side income much easier to plan around.
whoShouldUse: Employees estimating their federal tax, freelancers planning quarterly payments, and anyone comparing a raise, bonus, or additional income against its tax impact.

faq: Does this calculator include state taxes? — No, it models 2025 US federal income tax only.
What is the marginal vs effective rate? — The marginal rate applies to your next dollar; the effective rate is your average tax across all taxable income.
Do I itemize or take the standard deduction? — The standard deduction for your status is applied; itemized deductions and credits are not modeled.
Is my financial data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.
How are capital gains taxed? — Long-term capital gains have separate, lower brackets; this estimator models ordinary wage income.
Why does my marginal rate matter? — Every extra dollar you earn is taxed at that rate, so it tells you the real cost of a raise or bonus.
